cards.title: Notch calculator helper: RATING_SCALE, notchChange, notchCalculator (src/ratings/notch.mjs) with unit tests
cards.context: WHY: REQ-06-02 asks for a notch calculator helper. The analyst gives a previous and a current rating and gets back the signed notch change, the direction and the resulting Watchlist level (WL 0-4, higher is worse). Other parts of the Watchlist POC import this module, so the export names and signatures below are a fixed contract. T-02 (Indicator 12, src/indicators/countryRating.mjs) is built on notchChange from this file. REPO STATE: the repo is empty apart from src/.gitkeep and test/.gitkeep. package.json has "type":"module" and scripts.test = "node --test". CONVENTIONS (CLAUDE.md): plain Node 18+ ESM (.mjs). Do not add npm dependencies. Code in src/ratings must be pure functions with no I/O: no imports at all (no node:fs, node:http/https, fetch or process) and no console.* calls. Unit tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and go in test/ratings/notch.test.mjs. Write them test-first. FILE TO CREATE: src/ratings/notch.mjs, exporting exactly: (1) RATING_SCALE = Object.freeze(["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]): 19 entries, best first, frozen (push or index assignment throws TypeError in strict ESM). (2) export function notchChange(previous, current) returns the integer index(current) - index(previous) on RATING_SCALE. Positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged. Never return -0. (3) export function notchCalculator(previous, current) returns a new plain object with exactly the keys { notches, direction, wl }. notches === notchChange(previous, current), signed the same way (human decision CON-interface: BB -> BBB gives -3). direction is "downgrade" if notches > 0, "upgrade" if notches < 0, otherwise "unchanged". wl uses the Indicator 13 thresholds (C2, C6): notches >= 3 -> 2, notches === 2 -> 1, otherwise 0 (a 1-notch downgrade, any upgrade and unchanged all give 0). Both functions take exactly 2 declared parameters (fn.length === 2); no override, options or default parameter (C7). VALIDATION (C1, CON-errors): one shared internal helper, e.g. normalizeRating(value, argName). Check typeof value === 'string' first; a non-string (null, undefined, 42, {}) must throw a RangeError, never a TypeError, so do not call .trim() before the check. Then trim and upper-case and look it up in RATING_SCALE. Anything not found throws a RangeError ("", "   ", "BBB +", "CC", "D", "NR", "AAA+", "Baa1"). Applies to both arguments. notchCalculator gets the same RangeError by calling notchChange or the shared helper; do not wrap or translate it. The message should name the argument (previous/current) and the offending value and list the valid ratings; tests assert the RangeError type only. Do not change inputs; write nothing to stdout/stderr. OUT OF SCOPE: a separate Indicator 13 function; ratings outside the 19 steps; fetching ratings; UI, CLI or logging. WARNING: the original POC example 'BBB+ -> BB+ = 2 notches -> WL=1' is miscounted; the correct result is 3 notches -> WL=2 (C2). Do not copy it into tests. TESTS MUST COVER: every value in AC-1, AC-2, AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8; the AC-3 normalisation cases for notchChange and notchCalculator; the AC-4 invalid list in both argument positions (other arg "BBB") for notchChange and notchCalculator; the AC-9 exhaustive loop over all 361 pairs; and the notch.mjs part of AC-13 (.length === 2, inputs unchanged, no stdout/stderr output; the no-imports/no-console rule may be checked by reading the source text with node:fs inside the test only).
acceptance: 1. (AC-1) Given `src/ratings/notch.mjs` is imported, when `RATING_SCALE` is read, then it deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]` and `RATING_SCALE.length === 19`.

2. (AC-1, X-scale-immutability) Given the imported `RATING_SCALE`, when `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE)` is checked, `RATING_SCALE.push("CC")` is run and `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` is run (strict ESM), then `isFrozen` is `true`, both writes throw `TypeError`, `length` stays `19` and `RATING_SCALE[0]` stays `"AAA"`.

3. (AC-2) Given valid ratings, when `notchChange(previous, current)` is called, then it returns `index(current) − index(previous)`: `("BBB+","BB+")`→`3`, `("BBB+","BBB-")`→`2`, `("A","A-")`→`1`, `("AAA","CCC-")`→`18`, `("BB","BBB")`→`-3`, `("CCC-","AAA")`→`-18`, `("BBB","BBB")`→`0`.
4. (AC-2) Given any of the results in criterion 3, when it is checked, then `Number.isInteger(result) === true`, and for `("BBB","BBB")` `Object.is(result, 0) === true` (never `-0`).
5. (AC-3, C1) Given input with surrounding whitespace or a different letter case, when `notchChange` is called, then `notchChange(" bbb+ ","bb+")`→`3` and `notchChange("\tAa-\n","a+")`→`1`.
6. (AC-3, C1) Given lower-case input, when `notchCalculator("bbb+","BB+")` is called, then it deep-equals `{notches:3,direction:"downgrade",wl:2}`.

7. (AC-4, CON-errors) Given each invalid value `"CC"`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"AAA+"`, `"Baa1"`, `""`, `"   "`, `"BBB +"`, `null`, `undefined`, `42`, `{}` as `previous` (with `current = "BBB"`) and then as `current` (with `previous = "BBB"`), when `notchChange` is called, then `assert.throws(fn, RangeError)` passes. That is 24 cases, none of which may throw `TypeError` or return a value.

8. (AC-4, CON-errors) Given the same 12 invalid values in both positions, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `assert.throws(fn, RangeError)` passes for all 24 cases. The error is the validation `RangeError`, not wrapped or translated.

9. (AC-5, C2) Given a downgrade of 2 or more notches, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `("BBB+","BBB-")`→`{notches:2,direction:"downgrade",wl:1}`, `("BBB+","BB+")`→`{notches:3,direction:"downgrade",wl:2}`, `("BB","B")`→`{notches:3,direction:"downgrade",wl:2}` and `("AAA","CCC-")`→`{notches:18,direction:"downgrade",wl:2}`.
10. (AC-6, C6) Given a 1-notch downgrade, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `("A","A-")` and `("CCC","CCC-")` each deep-equal `{notches:1,direction:"downgrade",wl:0}`.

11. (AC-7, C3, CON-interface) Given an upgrade, when `notchCalculator` is called, then `("BB","BBB")`→`{notches:-3,direction:"upgrade",wl:0}`, `("BBB-","BBB+")`→`{notches:-2,direction:"upgrade",wl:0}`, `("A-","A")`→`{notches:-1,direction:"upgrade",wl:0}` and `("CCC-","AAA")`→`{notches:-18,direction:"upgrade",wl:0}`.

12. (AC-8, C3) Given an unchanged rating, when `notchCalculator("BBB","BBB")` and `notchCalculator("aaa"," AAA ")` are called, then each deep-equals `{notches:0,direction:"unchanged",wl:0}` and `Object.is(r.notches, 0) === true`.

13. (AC-9) Given all 361 pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE × RATING_SCALE`, when `r = notchCalculator(p, c)` and `n = notchChange(p, c)` are computed, then for every pair `Object.keys(r).sort()` deep-equals `["direction","notches","wl"]`, `r.notches === n`, `r.direction` is `"downgrade"`/`"upgrade"`/`"unchanged"` for `n > 0`/`n < 0`/`n === 0`, and `r.wl === (n >= 3 ? 2 : n === 2 ? 1 : 0)`.
14. (AC-13, C7) Given the module, when the function arity is read, then `notchChange.length === 2` and `notchCalculator.length === 2` (no override, options or default parameter).

15. (AC-13, C4, C8, CLAUDE.md) Given the source text of `src/ratings/notch.mjs` (the test may read it with `node:fs`), when it is inspected, then it has no `import` statement, no `require(`, no `fetch`, no `process`, no `node:fs`/`node:http`/`node:https` reference and no `console.` call.

16. (AC-13) Given variables `p = " bbb+ "` and `c = "bb+"`, and separately `o = {}`, when `notchChange(p, c)` and `notchCalculator(p, c)` are called (and `notchChange(o, "BBB")` throws), then `p === " bbb+ "`, `c === "bb+"` and `Object.keys(o).length === 0` afterwards. No call writes anything to stdout or stderr.
17. (TST-strategy, card verify) Given the card branch, when `node --test test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` runs from the repo root, then it exits `0` and the file contains tests for criteria 1–16.

cards.title: Indicator 12 country rating change WL: countryRatingChangeWl (src/indicators/countryRating.mjs) with unit tests
cards.context: WHY: REQ-03-12 defines Indicator 12 (Country rating change). It turns the notch change between the previous and current country rating into a Watchlist level of 0, 1 or 2. Other parts of the POC import this function, so its name and signature are a fixed contract. The contract says it is 'built on notchChange'. PREREQUISITE (T-01): src/ratings/notch.mjs already exists and exports RATING_SCALE (frozen array of 19 ratings, AAA..CCC-, best first), notchChange(previous, current) and notchCalculator(previous, current). notchChange returns the integer index(current) - index(previous): positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged. It trims and upper-cases its inputs and throws a RangeError for anything that is not one of the 19 ratings, including non-strings (null, undefined, 42, {}). Do not edit notch.mjs or its tests (out of this card's scope); if you find a defect there, report it. CONVENTIONS (CLAUDE.md): plain Node 18+ ESM (.mjs), no npm dependencies, pure functions with no I/O in src/indicators, no console.* calls. Unit tests use node:test and node:assert/strict in test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs. Write them test-first. FILE TO CREATE: src/indicators/countryRating.mjs. Its only import is import { notchChange } from '../ratings/notch.mjs'. No other imports and no use of node:fs, http/https, fetch or process. It exports function countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current), exactly 2 declared parameters (.length === 2), no override or edit parameter (C7). It computes n = notchChange(previous, current) and returns n >= 2 ? 2 : n === 1 ? 1 : 0 (1-notch downgrade gives 1, 2+ gives 2, upgrade or unchanged gives 0). Validation comes from notchChange: let its RangeError reach the caller unchanged (do not catch or wrap it). DELIBERATE DIFFERENCE (C6, PRD-conflicts): Indicator 12 thresholds (1 -> 1, 2+ -> 2) are NOT the notchCalculator thresholds (Indicator 13: 1 -> 0, 2 -> 1, 3+ -> 2). Do not harmonise them. AC-12 pins both side by side, so this card's tests must import notchCalculator as well. OUT OF SCOPE: fetching or pre-filling the country rating (C4); override, persistence or audit trail (C7); UI, CLI or logging (C8). WARNING: BBB+ -> BB+ is 3 notches, not 2. FINAL CARD: this card also closes AC-14. From the repo root, `node --test` (= npm test) must exit 0 and run both test/ratings/notch.test.mjs and test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs. package.json must still have no dependencies or devDependencies.
acceptance: 1. (AC-10, REQ-03-12) Given a downgrade, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then `("A","A-")`→`1`, `("CCC","CCC-")`→`1`, `("BBB+","BBB-")`→`2`, `("BBB+","BB+")`→`2` and `("AAA","CCC-")`→`2`, each with `typeof result === "number"`.
2. (AC-11, C3) Given an upgrade or an unchanged rating, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then `("BB","BBB")`, `("A-","A")`, `("CCC-","AAA")` and `("BBB","BBB")` each return `0`.

3. (AC-11) Given all 361 pairs `(p, c)` of `RATING_SCALE × RATING_SCALE`, when `w = countryRatingChangeWl(p, c)` and `n = notchChange(p, c)` are computed, then for every pair `w === (n >= 2 ? 2 : n === 1 ? 1 : 0)`.

4. (AC-12, C2, C6, PRD-conflicts) Given the same downgrade input, when `notchCalculator(p, c).wl` and `countryRatingChangeWl(p, c)` are both computed, then they are `0` / `1` for `("A","A-")`, `1` / `2` for `("BBB+","BBB-")` and `2` / `2` for `("BBB+","BB+")`.
5. (AC-3, C1) Given input with surrounding whitespace or a different letter case, when `countryRatingChangeWl("  a ","a-")` is called, then it returns `1`.

6. (AC-4, CON-errors) Given each invalid value `"CC"`, `"D"`, `"NR"`, `"AAA+"`, `"Baa1"`, `""`, `"   "`, `"BBB +"`, `null`, `undefined`, `42`, `{}` as `previous` (with `current = "BBB"`) and then as `current` (with `previous = "BBB"`), when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then `assert.throws(fn, RangeError)` passes in all 24 cases. Nothing may throw `TypeError` or return `0`, `NaN` or `undefined`, and the `RangeError` from `notchChange` must reach the caller unchanged (not caught or wrapped).

7. (AC-13, "built on notchChange") Given the source text of `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs`, when it is inspected, then it has exactly one `import` statement, `import { notchChange } from '../ratings/notch.mjs'`, and no `require(`, `fetch`, `process`, `node:fs`/`node:http`/`node:https` reference or `console.` call.
8. (AC-13, C7) Given the module, when the function arity is read, then `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2` (no override, edit or options parameter).

9. (AC-13, C8) Given variables `p = "  a "` and `c = "a-"`, and separately `o = {}`, when `countryRatingChangeWl(p, c)` is called (and `countryRatingChangeWl(o, "BBB")` throws), then `p === "  a "`, `c === "a-"` and `Object.keys(o).length === 0` afterwards. Nothing is written to stdout or stderr.

10. (AC-14, DEL-ci, TST-strategy) Given the job branch with T-01 and T-02 merged, when `node --test` (equivalently `npm test`) runs from the repo root, then it exits `0`, and its output shows tests from both `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs`, with `# fail 0`.

11. (AC-14) Given the two test files, when they are reviewed against the plan, then together they cover every value of AC-1 to AC-13. This is a reviewer/QA trace check: each AC maps to at least one named test.
12. (AC-14, ARC-stack) Given `package.json` after this card, when it is read, then it has no `dependencies` or `devDependencies` key and `scripts.test` is still `"node --test"`.
